intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文旧车比赛线记忆：每年旧车赛、很多车参加、开赛前很兴奋、漂亮的 Rolls-Royce、奇特的三轮 Benz、发动机爆响后开赛、很多车抛锚、司机在车底修车、少数车完赛、冠军 40 mph 下坡难停，最后大家觉得它和现代赛车不同但同样刺激。读的时候注意数量词、最高级、比较级和修车喜剧句的重音。

sentences.text: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：每年都会为旧车举行一次比赛。Once a year 先停一下，a race is held 用被动语态把重点放在比赛本身。

sentences.text: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：去年很多车参加，比赛开始前非常令人兴奋。长句按 A lot of cars entered / there was a great deal of excitement / just before it began 分组。

sentences.text: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：最漂亮的车之一是 Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost。one of the most handsome cars 连起来读，proper noun 稳稳读清楚。
focus_words: One of the most handsome cars

sentences.text: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：最特别的车是一辆只有三个轮子的 Benz。most unusual 和 only three wheels 要重读，让这辆老车的奇特感出来。

sentences.text: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它造于 1885 年，是参赛车里最老的一辆。Built in 1885 后短停，oldest car taking part 读出历史感。

sentences.text: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：很多车在赛道上抛锚，有些司机在车底修车的时间比坐在车里的时间还多。broke down on the course 读清原因，under their cars than in them 读出幽默对比。

sentences.text: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour -- much faster than any of its rivals.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：获胜的车达到每小时 40 英里，比任何对手都快得多。forty miles an hour 是速度短语，much faster than any of its rivals 要读出比较级加强。

sentences.text: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它和现代赛车很不同，但一点也不缺少刺激。different from modern car races 后转折，no less exciting 读成“同样刺激”的收尾金句。
